title: Manufacturing RL | Expanded Research and PPO

list.name: run_id
list.query: SELECT run_id AS __value,(metadata->>'name')||' | '||run_id AS __text FROM extended_runs ORDER BY metadata->>'created_at' DESC

panels.title: Host CPU usage
panels.description: Host-wide resource use at the selected time range endpoint; not the training process alone. Refreshes live when the range ends at now. Utilization does not measure schedule quality.

panels.title: Host memory usage
panels.description: Host-wide resource use at the selected time range endpoint; not the training process alone. Refreshes live when the range ends at now. Utilization does not measure schedule quality. psutil percentage = (total - available) / total.

panels.title: CP-SAT budget used · P95
panels.description: P95 across individual CP-SAT planning calls in the selected run, including the initial plan. Dynamic episode totals are excluded. Expanded-static uses solver runtime / solver limit; other campaigns include preparation and validation in the planning budget. The full selected run is used regardless of the time range. 100% is the allocated budget; orange indicates reaching/exceeding it. Display scale is 0–120%; the numeric value is not capped.

targets.rawSql:
WITH calls AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN payload ? 'budget_s' THEN (payload->>'runtime_ms')::float
             ELSE (payload->>'solver_runtime_ms')::float END AS latency_ms,
        COALESCE(payload->>'budget_s',payload->>'time_limit_s')::float AS budget_s
 FROM extended_records WHERE run_id=${run_id:sqlstring} AND payload->>'method'='CP-SAT' AND NOT (payload ? 'decisions')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT (d->>'runtime_ms')::float,(d->>'budget_s')::float
 FROM extended_records CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(payload->'decisions') d
 WHERE run_id=${run_id:sqlstring} AND payload->>'method'='CP-SAT'
) SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY 100*latency_ms/(1000*budget_s)) AS budget_used_percent FROM calls WHERE budget_s>0

panels.title: CP-SAT planning time · P95
panels.description: P95 across individual CP-SAT planning calls in the selected run, including the initial plan. Dynamic episode totals are excluded. Expanded-static uses solver runtime / solver limit; other campaigns include preparation and validation in the planning budget. The full selected run is used regardless of the time range. Includes different configured budgets; see detailed rows for each budget.

targets.rawSql:
WITH calls AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN payload ? 'budget_s' THEN (payload->>'runtime_ms')::float
             ELSE (payload->>'solver_runtime_ms')::float END AS latency_ms,
        COALESCE(payload->>'budget_s',payload->>'time_limit_s')::float AS budget_s
 FROM extended_records WHERE run_id=${run_id:sqlstring} AND payload->>'method'='CP-SAT' AND NOT (payload ? 'decisions')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT (d->>'runtime_ms')::float,(d->>'budget_s')::float
 FROM extended_records CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(payload->'decisions') d
 WHERE run_id=${run_id:sqlstring} AND payload->>'method'='CP-SAT'
) SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS planning_ms FROM calls WHERE budget_s>0

SELECT metadata->>'name' AS campaign,metadata->>'status' AS status,(SELECT count(*) FROM extended_records r WHERE r.run_id=extended_runs.run_id) AS records FROM extended_runs WHERE run_id=${run_id:sqlstring}

panels.title: Mean scheduling KPIs · group details in row label

targets.rawSql: SELECT (payload->>'instance')||' | '||(payload->>'method')||COALESCE(' '||(payload->>'budget_s')||'s',' '||(payload->>'time_limit_s')||'s','')||COALESCE(' | '||(payload->>'objective'),'')||' | '||(payload->>'scenario') AS case,round(avg((payload->>'makespan')::numeric),2) AS makespan,round(avg((payload->>'total_tardiness')::numeric),2) AS tardiness,round(avg((payload->>'runtime_ms')::numeric),2) AS runtime_ms FROM extended_records WHERE run_id=${run_id:sqlstring} AND payload ? 'makespan' AND COALESCE(payload->>'record_type','test')='test' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Scheduling KPIs · one row per evaluation

targets.rawSql: SELECT step,payload->>'instance' AS instance,payload->>'scenario' AS scenario,payload->>'method' AS method,payload->>'objective' AS objective,(payload->>'seed')::int AS seed,payload->>'status' AS status,COALESCE(payload->>'budget_s',payload->>'time_limit_s') AS budget_s,(payload->>'makespan')::float AS makespan,(payload->>'total_tardiness')::float AS tardiness,(payload->>'runtime_ms')::float AS runtime_ms,(payload->>'best_bound')::float AS bound,payload->>'solution_source' AS solution_source FROM extended_records WHERE run_id=${run_id:sqlstring} AND payload ? 'makespan' AND COALESCE(payload->>'record_type','test')='test' ORDER BY step

panels.title: PPO validation objective · lower is better

targets.rawSql: SELECT (payload->>'recorded_at')::timestamptz AS time,'seed '||(payload->>'seed') AS metric,(payload->>'objective_score')::float AS value FROM extended_records WHERE run_id=${run_id:sqlstring} AND payload->>'record_type'='validation' ORDER BY time

panels.title: PPO episode reward · gamma=1 objective identity

targets.rawSql: SELECT (payload->>'recorded_at')::timestamptz AS time,'seed '||(payload->>'seed') AS metric,(payload->>'train_episode_return')::float AS value FROM extended_records WHERE run_id=${run_id:sqlstring} AND payload ? 'train_episode_return' ORDER BY time

panels.title: PPO training losses · recorded optimizer updates

targets.rawSql: SELECT (payload->>'recorded_at')::timestamptz AS time,'seed '||(payload->>'seed')||' '||v.key AS metric,(v.value)::float AS value FROM extended_records CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(payload) v WHERE run_id=${run_id:sqlstring} AND v.key IN ('train_policy_gradient_loss','train_value_loss','train_approx_kl') ORDER BY time

SELECT (payload->>'recorded_at')::timestamptz AS time,'seed '||(payload->>'seed')||' '||v.key AS metric,(v.value)::float AS value FROM extended_records CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(payload) v WHERE run_id=${run_id:sqlstring} AND v.key IN ('train_entropy_loss','gradient_norm_before_clip') ORDER BY time

SELECT step,payload->>'seed' AS seed,payload->>'env_steps' AS env_steps,payload->>'training_steps_per_second' AS steps_per_second,payload->>'ram_mb' AS ram_mb,payload->>'training_time_s' AS training_time_s,payload->>'checkpoint_bytes' AS checkpoint_bytes FROM extended_records WHERE run_id=${run_id:sqlstring} AND payload->>'record_type' IN ('training','training_summary') ORDER BY step DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT step,payload->>'instance' AS instance,payload->>'scenario' AS scenario,payload->>'method' AS method,payload->>'objective' AS objective,payload->>'seed' AS seed,payload->>'budget_s' AS budget_s,payload->>'rescheduling_decisions' AS replans,payload->>'cumulative_start_shift' AS start_shift,payload->>'cumulative_machine_changes' AS machine_changes,payload->>'mean_replanning_ms' AS mean_replanning_ms,payload->>'fallback_count' AS fallback_count,payload->>'constraint_violation_count' AS violations FROM extended_records WHERE run_id=${run_id:sqlstring} AND payload ? 'decisions' ORDER BY step

panels.title: Each observed event and solver certificate

targets.rawSql: SELECT step,payload->>'instance' AS instance,payload->>'method' AS method,d->'event'->>'type' AS event,d->'event'->>'time' AS simulation_time,d->>'observed_job_count' AS known_jobs,d->>'status' AS solver_status,d->>'solution_source' AS solution_source,d->>'runtime_ms' AS latency_ms,d->>'makespan' AS planned_makespan,d->>'total_tardiness' AS planned_tardiness FROM extended_records CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(payload->'decisions') d WHERE run_id=${run_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY step,(d->'event'->>'time')::int

SELECT step,payload->>'instance' AS instance,payload->>'method' AS method,payload->>'constraint_violation_count' AS violations,payload->>'solver_response_objective_mismatch' AS response_mismatch,payload->>'invalid_bound_discarded' AS invalid_bound_discarded,payload->>'budget_overrun_ms' AS budget_overrun_ms FROM extended_records WHERE run_id=${run_id:sqlstring} AND (payload->>'constraint_violation_count' IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY step
